platform: Native Windows x64; Node standard-library bridge with opt-in Messages conversion. External App relay0.2.0 at cfb409bbce234f0ce8e80c89f21bf7afe79a6e87 requires Python3.12+ and mitmproxy12.3.1. Selected-model target results were reviewed; pristine-machine, all-model and reboot acceptance remain pending.

open_findings.summary: The original App relay accepts arbitrary local callers; bridge authentication does not secure its direct port on a multi-user machine.
Messages-only models require explicit protocol conversion with bounded tools, thinking and history support; Sydney, hosted tools and Windows compaction remain unsupported.
The observed target reused an existing GitHub installation; a pristine-machine rebuild, full model matrix and logout/reboot recovery remain unverified.
A relative-path shell read failed after successful patch creation, while an explicit workdir/absolute-path read passed; the underlying shell-directory cause was not established.
